motivation: Gate B.0.3 adds a deterministic signed Trial B fixture that first completes a positive Workspace B read, then attempts a scoped symlink read to Workspace A. A failed signed-app build exposed a missing explicit Swift return in the existing experimental Host result-digest validator; this bounded compile fix is included with a regression assertion. The evidence evaluator binds the symlink target to Trial A and requires classified refusal evidence.
invariants: Production Kernel, ABI, workspace scope, approval authority, production trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. The new fixture adds no Kernel or Launcher authority and does not modify the existing experimental trusted Launcher overlay. Result equality alone is not treated as replay; each result remains bound to its own runtime trial, request, approval, parent terminal, and DSH delivery.
authority_delta: 0 production Kernel authority, 0 Kernel ABI, 0 production workspace-scope authority, 0 production trusted-runtime delta, 0 production dependencies, 0 new trusted processes or IPC operations. real_os_tests: The first fresh signed-app build attempt stopped at Swift compilation because the experimental Host result-digest validator omitted an explicit return. No app was signed and no UI trial ran. The compile defect is corrected in this change; the one-rebuild, no-model Trial A/B signed acceptance remains NOT_RUN.
trusted_delta: Production trusted source delta is 0. The experimental Host result-digest validator receives an explicit return required by Swift compilation; its Boolean validation behavior is unchanged. The deterministic AgentHost fixture adds a positive Workspace B read before a second scoped read, and the evidence runner records the refusal layer and normalized observed denial diagnostic. The pair evaluator requires the B symlink target digest to equal Trial A canary digest. Independent review remains pending.
